prime-check.output: function isPrime(n) { if (n < 2) return false; for (let i = 2; i * i <= n; i++) if (n % i === 0) return false; return true; }

debounce.output: function debounce(fn, ms) { let t; return (...args) => { clearTimeout(t); t = setTimeout(() => fn(...args), ms); }; }
